sources.title: avans06/faster-whisper-large-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Whisper large-v3 model for CTranslate2 This repository contains the conversion of openai/whisper-large-v3 to the CTranslate2 model format. This model can be used in CTranslate2 or projects based on CTranslate2 such as faster-whisper.

sources.title: faster-whisper-large-v3 - regolo.ai
sources.snippet: faster‑whisper‑large‑v3 is a CTranslate2‑optimized conversion of OpenAI's Whisper large‑v3 that delivers high‑accuracy multilingual speech‑to‑text with significantly lower latency and VRAM usage for real‑time and batch transcription.

sources.title: Faster Whisper - Fast and Accurate AI Speech-to-Text Software
sources.snippet: Faster Whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using the high-performance CTranslate2 runtime. It delivers the same trusted speech-to-text accuracy while running dramatically faster and lighter — making professional transcription possible on everyday hardware.
